title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・一流のライバル

text_block_list.text: King Halo has won the autumn Tenno Sho. She closes her eyes and embraces the cheers of the crowd before turning away from the applause.
She faces her two fiercest competitors, Special Week and Seiun Sky.
The three exchange their deepest feelings—their frustrations, their regrets, and their gratitude—and laugh together.
A gust of wind blows past them, carrying their voices toward the future where they'll continue to run as rivals and as friends.
